title: Ranch Yoga + Sound Bath with Horses | Topanga
description: Escape the city, practice yoga, relax into a sound bath, and spend time with horses in the Topanga mountains.
long_description:
Escape the city, practice yoga, relax into a sound bath, and spend time with horses in the Topanga mountains.

About this Event

Leave the chaos of the city for a peaceful morning immersed in nature at a beautiful private ranch tucked in the mountains of Topanga.
This gathering is an opportunity to step away from the noise of daily life and reconnect with your body, breath, and the natural world. Surrounded by open land, fresh air, and gentle horses, we’ll create space to ground, reset, and come back into balance.
The morning begins with time to arrive slowly, connect with the horses, and settle into the calm rhythm of the ranch. We’ll then move through a grounding outdoor yoga practice designed to release tension and reconnect you to your body. After yoga, we’ll close with a short immersive sound bath to help the body fully relax and integrate.
Whether you're seeking movement, nature, or simply a quiet reset, this gathering offers a beautiful way to reconnect with yourself.
Event Schedule
9:00–9:30 AM — Arrival + Ranch Time
Arrive at the ranch, settle in, connect with the horses, and meet the community while taking in the peaceful Topanga mountain surroundings.
9:30–10:15 AM — Grounding Yoga Practice
A gentle, grounding outdoor yoga class designed to help you reconnect with your body and move through your practice with intention.
10:15–10:30 AM — Sound Bath Integration
Close the morning with a relaxing sound bath to calm the nervous system and integrate the experience.
Provided at the Ranch
• Yoga mats
• Iced tea & refreshments
• Carrots to feed horsies :)
What to Bring
• Water bottle
• Comfortable clothes to flow in
• Closed-toed shoes (cowboy boots & cowgirl attire recommended ;))
